meta.purpose: Short sentences the patient actually sees. Each one restates a field in drugs.json (the evidence text the verifier checks against) in plain words. Doses and times never come from here: they come from the confirmed medicine label.

status_values.draft: Drafted with an AI model from drugs.json; needs a pharmacist or doctor to review the English and a Chinese reader to review the Mandarin before the demo.
status_values.reviewed: Checked by a human; record who and when in reviewed_by / reviewed_on.

rules: Every entry names the drugs.json field it restates (evidence_field). The slot check compares drug, number, unit and frequency against that field.
Directive sentences from the leaflet (stop, see a doctor) are shown with attribution: 'The leaflet says ...'.
Never add facts that are not in the evidence field.

entries.en: Amlodipine lowers blood pressure. It relaxes and widens the blood vessels.
entries.zh: 氨氯地平用来降血压，它让血管放松、变宽。

entries.en: The leaflet says you can take it alongside a meal or on an empty stomach.
entries.zh: 单张写着：随餐吃或空腹吃都可以。
entries.note_2026_10_09: Reworded to the leaflet wording so the slot check passes (no number or timing the leaflet does not state).

entries.en: The leaflet says to check with your doctor or pharmacist before you stop taking it.
entries.zh: 单张写着：要停药之前，先问医生或药剂师。

entries.en: The leaflet says: if you forget a dose, take it when you remember, then take the next one at the usual time. Do not double up to make up for the missed one.
entries.zh: 单张写着：忘了吃，想起来就补上，下一次照平常的时间吃。不要为了补漏掉的那次而加倍。
entries.note_2026_10_09: Reworded to the leaflet wording so the slot check passes (no number or timing the leaflet does not state).

entries.en: Common side effects listed in the leaflet: swollen legs, headache, a face that feels flushed and warm, and feeling dizzy or light-headed when you stand up.
entries.zh: 单张列出的常见副作用：腿脚肿、头痛、脸发红发热，坐着或躺着站起来时头晕。

entries.en: The leaflet says to avoid grapefruit while you are on amlodipine.
entries.zh: 单张写着：吃氨氯地平期间不要吃西柚。

entries.evidence_field: other_points:Other medicines to tell the doctor about
entries.en: Tell your doctor or pharmacist about every other medicine you take, including supplements, traditional medicines and herbal products.
entries.zh: 要告诉医生或药剂师你在吃的所有其他药，包括保健品、传统药和草药。

entries.en: The leaflet says: if your face, eyes, lips or tongue swell, you have trouble breathing, or you get an itchy rash all over your body, stop the medicine and see a doctor straight away.
entries.zh: 单张写着：如果脸、眼睛、嘴唇或舌头肿起来，呼吸困难，或者全身发痒起疹子，要停药并马上看医生。

entries.en: Losartan lowers blood pressure. It stops a substance in the body from narrowing the blood vessels.
entries.zh: 氯沙坦用来降血压，它阻止体内一种让血管变窄的物质起作用。

entries.en: The leaflet says you can take it together with a meal or on an empty stomach.
entries.zh: 单张写着：随餐吃或空腹吃都可以。
entries.note_2026_10_09: Reworded to the leaflet wording so the slot check passes (no number or timing the leaflet does not state).

entries.en: The leaflet says not to stop it on your own: check with your doctor first.
entries.zh: 单张写着：不要自己停药，先问医生。

entries.en: The leaflet says: take a forgotten dose when you remember. If the next dose is nearly due, just take that one as usual. Never take a double dose to catch up.
entries.zh: 单张写着：忘了吃，想起来就补上；如果快到下一次了，就照常吃下一次。不要加倍，也不要多吃来补。
entries.note_2026_10_09: Reworded to the leaflet wording so the slot check passes (no number or timing the leaflet does not state).

entries.en: The leaflet says your doctor may check your blood potassium and how your kidneys are working while you take losartan.
entries.zh: 单张写着：吃氯沙坦期间，医生可能会检查你血里的钾和肾功能。

entries.en: Ibuprofen is an anti-inflammatory painkiller (an NSAID). It is used for pain, swelling and fever, including joint and muscle pain.
entries.zh: 布洛芬是一种消炎止痛药（NSAID），用于疼痛、肿胀和发烧，包括关节和肌肉痛。

entries.en: The leaflet says to take it with food where possible, to reduce stomach upset.
entries.zh: 单张写着：尽量随餐吃，可以减少胃不舒服。
entries.note_2026_10_09: Reworded to the leaflet wording so the slot check passes (no number or timing the leaflet does not state).

entries.en: The leaflet says to tell a healthcare professional before taking it if you have had stomach ulcers or bleeding, asthma, kidney or heart problems, or a stroke, and about every other medicine you take.
entries.zh: 单张写着：如果你有过胃溃疡或出血、哮喘、肾脏或心脏问题、中风，吃之前要先告诉医护人员，也要告诉他们你在吃的所有其他药。

entries.en: The leaflet says to avoid long use that a doctor is not supervising, because it may raise the chance of heart attack, stroke, stomach ulcers and kidney problems.
entries.zh: 单张写着：没有医生监督时不要长期吃，因为可能增加心脏病发作、中风、胃溃疡和肾脏问题的风险。

entries.en: The leaflet says not to combine it with another NSAID such as naproxen or diclofenac.
entries.zh: 单张写着：不要和其他同类止痛药（例如 naproxen、diclofenac）一起吃。

entries.en: Paracetamol (also called acetaminophen) brings down fever and eases headache, body aches and pain.
entries.zh: 扑热息痛（也叫 acetaminophen）用来退烧，缓解头痛、身体酸痛和疼痛。

entries.en: The leaflet says not to use two products that both contain paracetamol at the same time.
entries.zh: 单张写着：不要同时吃两种都含扑热息痛的药。
